evals.prompt: I'm running a study on workplace productivity tools. I need US-based participants who are employed full-time and aged between 25 and 45.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches the available filter list, then recommends a country or residence filter targeting the US, an employment status filter for full-time employment, and an age range filter with lower bound 25 and upper bound 45. Each recommendation includes the filter_id and the specific values or range to use.
assertions: The agent runs 'prolific filters -n' before making any recommendations
The agent recommends a filter targeting US-based participants and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends a filter for full-time employment and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends an age range filter with a lower bound of 25 and upper bound of 45
The agent provides filter_id values for every filter it recommends
The agent explains why each recommended filter matches the stated requirement
The agent formats at least one recommendation with selected_values or selected_range in the Prolific API JSON structure

evals.prompt: I want to study online learning habits among working-age adults in the UK who hold at least a university degree
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches the filter list, recommends a UK country of residence filter (using current-country-of-residence or uk-country-of-residence), an education level filter targeting university-degree holders or above (choices 4, 5, or 6 in highest-education-level-completed), and an age filter for working-age adults (e.g. 18–65 using the age filter). Each recommendation includes the filter_id and selected values.
assertions: The agent runs 'prolific filters -n' before making any recommendations
The agent recommends a filter targeting UK-based participants and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends an education filter targeting university degree level or above and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends an age filter for working-age adults (e.g. lower bound 18, upper bound 65) and provides its filter_id
The agent provides filter_id values for every filter it recommends
The agent formats at least one recommendation with selected_values or selected_range in the Prolific API JSON structure

evals.prompt: I'm researching the impact of early childcare on parental wellbeing. My participants must be parents with at least one child under 5 years old, currently not in employment, and must have English as their first language.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches the filter list and recommends filters for: parental status (using the 'children' filter, filter_id: children, selecting 'Yes'); year of birth of youngest child (using year-of-birth-of-youngest-child, selecting years 2021–2026 to capture children under 5 as of 2026); employment status excluding current employment (using employment-status, selecting choices for 'Unemployed' or 'Not in paid work'); and first language set to English (using first-language, selecting 'English'). Each recommendation includes filter_id and values.
assertions: The agent runs 'prolific filters  -n' before making any recommendations
The agent recommends a filter related to parental status or having children and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends a filter using year-of-birth-of-youngest-child or years-of-birth-of-your-children to identify children under 5 (born 2021 or later as of 2026) and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends a filter targeting participants who are not currently employed and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends a filter for English as a first language and provides its filter_id
The agent provides filter_id values for every filter it recommends
The agent formats at least one recommendation with selected_values or selected_range in the Prolific API JSON structure

evals.prompt: I'm studying how people respond to unexpected life events. I need participants who have experienced a major personal crisis in the last 6 months.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches the filter list, acknowledges that there is no filter directly matching 'recent personal crisis', and suggests the closest available alternatives (such as health-related filters or open screener questions), explaining why a direct match is unavailable.
assertions: The agent runs 'prolific filters  -n' before responding
The agent explicitly states that no filter directly matches the requirement for recent personal crisis experience
The agent suggests at least one alternative or workaround
The agent does not fabricate a filter_id that does not exist in the available filter list
